verses.original: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר יְהוָה֙ אֵלַ֔י אִם־ יַעֲמֹ֨ד מֹשֶׁ֤ה וּשְׁמוּאֵל֙ לְפָנַ֔י אֵ֥ין נַפְשִׁ֖י אֶל־ הָעָ֣ם הַזֶּ֑ה שַׁלַּ֥ח מֵֽעַל־ פָּנַ֖י וְיֵצֵֽאוּ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer Yah·weh ’ê·lay ’im- ya·‘ă·mōḏ mō·šeh ū·šə·mū·’êl lə·p̄ā·nay ’ên nap̄·šî ’el- hā·‘ām haz·zeh šal·laḥ mê·‘al- pā·nay wə·yê·ṣê·’ū
verses.literal: Then the LORD said to me Even if Moses and Samuel should stand before Me My heart would not go out to this people Send them from My presence and let them go
verses.literalPt: Disse-me Jeová: Ainda que Moisés e Samuel se apresentassem diante de mim, todavia, a minha alma não poderia estar com este povo; lança-os de diante de mim, e saiam.

verses.original: וְהָיָ֛ה כִּֽי־ יֹאמְר֥וּ אֵלֶ֖יךָ אָ֣נָה נֵצֵ֑א וְאָמַרְתָּ֨ אֲלֵיהֶ֜ם כֹּֽה־ אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֗ה אֲשֶׁ֨ר לַמָּ֤וֶת לַמָּ֙וֶת֙ וַאֲשֶׁ֤ר לַחֶ֙רֶב֙ לַחֶ֔רֶב וַאֲשֶׁ֤ר לָֽרָעָב֙ לָֽרָעָ֔ב וַאֲשֶׁ֥ר לַשְּׁבִ֖י לַשֶּֽׁבִי׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hā·yāh kî- yō·mə·rū ’ê·le·ḵā ’ā·nāh nê·ṣê wə·’ā·mar·tā ’ă·lê·hem kōh- ’ā·mar Yah·weh ’ă·šer lam·mā·weṯ lam·mā·weṯ wa·’ă·šer la·ḥe·reḇ la·ḥe·reḇ wa·’ă·šer lā·rā·‘āḇ lā·rā·‘āḇ wa·’ă·šer laš·šə·ḇî laš·še·ḇî
verses.literal: If they ask you . . . Where shall we go you are to tell them that this is what the LORD says Those destined for death to death those destined for the sword to the sword those destined for famine to famine and those destined for captivity to captivity
verses.literalPt: Quando te perguntarem: Para onde sairemos? Então, lhes responderás: Assim diz Jeová: O que é para a morte, para a morte; o que é para a espada, para a espada; o que é para a fome, para a fome; e o que é para o cativeiro, para o cativeiro.

verses.original: וּפָקַדְתִּ֨י עֲלֵיהֶ֜ם אַרְבַּ֤ע מִשְׁפָּחוֹת֙ נְאֻם־ יְהוָ֔ה אֶת־ הַחֶ֣רֶב לַֽהֲרֹ֔ג וְאֶת־ הַכְּלָבִ֖ים לִסְחֹ֑ב וְאֶת־ ע֧וֹף הַשָּׁמַ֛יִם וְאֶת־ בֶּהֱמַ֥ת הָאָ֖רֶץ לֶאֱכֹ֥ל וּלְהַשְׁחִֽית׃
verses.transliteration: ū·p̄ā·qaḏ·tî ‘ă·lê·hem ’ar·ba‘ miš·pā·ḥō·wṯ nə·’um- Yah·weh ’eṯ- ha·ḥe·reḇ la·hă·rōḡ wə·’eṯ- hak·kə·lā·ḇîm lis·ḥōḇ wə·’eṯ- ‘ō·wp̄ haš·šā·ma·yim wə·’eṯ- be·hĕ·maṯ hā·’ā·reṣ le·’ĕ·ḵōl ū·lə·haš·ḥîṯ
verses.literal: I will appoint over them four kinds of destroyers declares the LORD the sword to kill the dogs to drag away and the birds of the air and beasts of the earth to devour and destroy
verses.literalPt: Porei sobre eles quatro sortes de castigo, diz Jeová: a espada para matar, e os cães para dilacerarem, e as aves do céu e os animais para devorarem e destruírem.

verses.original: וּנְתַתִּ֣ים לִזְוָעָה לְכֹ֖ל מַמְלְכ֣וֹת הָאָ֑רֶץ בִּ֠גְלַל מְנַשֶּׁ֤ה בֶן־ יְחִזְקִיָּ֙הוּ֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ יְהוּדָ֔ה עַ֥ל אֲשֶׁר־ עָשָׂ֖ה בִּירוּשָׁלִָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: ū·nə·ṯat·tîm liz·wå̄·ʿå̄h lə·ḵōl mam·lə·ḵō·wṯ hā·’ā·reṣ biḡ·lal mə·naš·šeh ḇen- yə·ḥiz·qî·yā·hū me·leḵ yə·hū·ḏāh ‘al ’ă·šer- ‘ā·śāh bî·rū·šā·lim
verses.literal: I will make them a horror to all the kingdoms of the earth because of what Manasseh son of Hezekiah king of Judah did in Jerusalem
verses.literalPt: Farei que sejam um espetáculo horrendo a todos os reinos da terra, por causa de Manassés, filho de Ezequias, rei de Judá, e por causa do que fez em Jerusalém.

verses.original: כִּ֠י מִֽי־ יַחְמֹ֤ל עָלַ֙יִךְ֙ יְר֣וּשָׁלִַ֔ם וּמִ֖י יָנ֣וּד לָ֑ךְ וּמִ֣י יָס֔וּר לִשְׁאֹ֥ל לְשָׁלֹ֖ם לָֽךְ׃
verses.transliteration: kî mî- yaḥ·mōl ‘ā·la·yiḵ yə·rū·šā·lim ū·mî yā·nūḏ lāḵ ū·mî yā·sūr liš·’ōl lə·šā·lōm lāḵ
verses.literal: Who will have pity on you O Jerusalem Who will mourn for you Who will turn aside to ask about your welfare
verses.literalPt: Pois quem se compadecerá de ti, Jerusalém? Quem se condoerá de ti? Ou quem se desviará para perguntar pela tua paz?

verses.original: אַ֣תְּ נָטַ֥שְׁתְּ אֹתִ֛י נְאֻם־ יְהוָ֖ה אָח֣וֹר תֵּלֵ֑כִי וָאַ֨ט אֶת־ יָדִ֤י עָלַ֙יִךְ֙ וָֽאַשְׁחִיתֵ֔ךְ נִלְאֵ֖יתִי הִנָּחֵֽם׃
verses.transliteration: ’at nā·ṭašt ’ō·ṯî nə·’um- Yah·weh ’ā·ḥō·wr tê·lê·ḵî wā·’aṭ ’eṯ- yā·ḏî ‘ā·la·yiḵ wā·’aš·ḥî·ṯêḵ nil·’ê·ṯî hin·nā·ḥêm
verses.literal: You have forsaken Me declares the LORD You have turned your back . . . So I will stretch out My hand against you and I will destroy you I am weary of showing compassion
verses.literalPt: Tu me rejeitaste, diz Jeová, voltaste para trás; por isso, estendi a minha mão contra ti e te destruí; cansado estou de me arrepender.

verses.original: וָאֶזְרֵ֥ם בְּמִזְרֶ֖ה בְּשַׁעֲרֵ֣י הָאָ֑רֶץ שִׁכַּ֤לְתִּי אִבַּ֙דְתִּי֙ אֶת־ עַמִּ֔י מִדַּרְכֵיהֶ֖ם לוֹא־ שָֽׁבוּ׃
verses.transliteration: wā·’ez·rêm bə·miz·reh bə·ša·‘ă·rê hā·’ā·reṣ šik·kal·tî ’ib·baḏ·tî ’eṯ- ‘am·mî mid·dar·ḵê·hem lō·w- šā·ḇū
verses.literal: I will scatter them with a winnowing fork at the gates of the land I will bereave and destroy My people who have not turned from their ways
verses.literalPt: Eu os cirandei com a pá nas portas da terra; já desfilhei, já destruí o meu povo; não voltaram dos seus caminhos.

verses.original: עָֽצְמוּ־ לִ֤י אַלְמְנֹתָו֙ מֵח֣וֹל יַמִּ֔ים הֵבֵ֨אתִי לָהֶ֥ם עַל־ אֵ֛ם בָּח֖וּר שֹׁדֵ֣ד בַּֽצָּהֳרָ֑יִם הִפַּ֤לְתִּי עָלֶ֙יהָ֙ פִּתְאֹ֔ם עִ֖יר וּבֶהָלֽוֹת׃
verses.transliteration: ‘ā·ṣə·mū- lî ʾal·mə·nō·ṯå̄w mê·ḥō·wl yam·mîm hê·ḇê·ṯî lā·hem ‘al- ’êm bā·ḥūr šō·ḏêḏ baṣ·ṣā·ho·rā·yim hip·pal·tî ‘ā·le·hā piṯ·’ōm ‘îr ū·ḇe·hā·lō·wṯ
verses.literal: I will make their widows more numerous than the sand of the sea I will bring . . . a destroyer at noon against the mothers of young men I will suddenly bring upon them anguish and dismay
verses.literalPt: As suas viúvas se me têm multiplicado mais do que a areia dos mares; fiz vir sobre eles, até sobre a mãe de mancebos, um despojador ao meio-dia; fiz cair de repente sobre ela angústia e pavor.

verses.original: אֻמְלְלָ֞ה יֹלֶ֣דֶת הַשִּׁבְעָ֗ה נָפְחָ֥ה נַפְשָׁ֛הּ בָּאָה שִׁמְשָׁ֛הּ בְּעֹ֥ד יוֹמָ֖ם בּ֣וֹשָׁה וְחָפֵ֑רָה וּשְׁאֵֽרִיתָ֗ם לַחֶ֧רֶב אֶתֵּ֛ן לִפְנֵ֥י אֹיְבֵיהֶ֖ם נְאֻם־ יְהוָֽה׃ס
verses.transliteration: ’um·lə·lāh yō·le·ḏeṯ haš·šiḇ·‘āh nā·p̄ə·ḥāh nap̄·šāh bå̄·ʾå̄h šim·šāh bə·‘ōḏ yō·w·mām bō·wō·šāh wə·ḥā·p̄ê·rāh ū·šə·’ê·rî·ṯām la·ḥe·reḇ ’et·tên lip̄·nê ’ō·yə·ḇê·hem nə·’um- Yah·weh
verses.literal: The mother of seven will grow faint she will breathe her last breath Her sun will set while it is still day she will be disgraced and humiliated And the rest I will put to the sword in the presence of their enemies declares the LORD
verses.literalPt: Desfalece a que teve sete filhos; exalou o seu espírito, já se pôs o seu sol enquanto ainda era dia; ficou envergonhada e confundida. Os que ficaram deles, entregá-los-ei à espada diante dos seus inimigos, diz Jeová.

verses.original: אֽוֹי־ לִ֣י אִמִּ֔י כִּ֣י יְלִדְתִּ֗נִי אִ֥ישׁ רִ֛יב וְאִ֥ישׁ מָד֖וֹן לְכָל־ הָאָ֑רֶץ לֹֽא־ נָשִׁ֥יתִי וְלֹא־ נָֽשׁוּ־ בִ֖י כֻּלֹּ֥ה מְקַלְלַֽונִי׃ס
verses.transliteration: ’ō·w- lî ’im·mî kî yə·liḏ·ti·nî ’îš rîḇ wə·’îš mā·ḏō·wn lə·ḵāl hā·’ā·reṣ lō- nā·šî·ṯî wə·lō- nā·šū- ḇî kul·lōh mə·qal·la·w·nî
verses.literal: Woe to me my mother that you have borne me a man of strife . . . and conflict in all the land I have neither lent nor borrowed yet everyone curses me
verses.literalPt: Ai de mim, minha mãe! Porque me deste à luz homem de rixas e homem de contendas para a terra toda! Nunca lhes dei dinheiro à usura, nem me deram a mim à usura; contudo, cada um deles me amaldiçoa.

verses.original: אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֔ה אִם־ לֹ֥א שָׁרוֹתִךָ לְט֑וֹב אִם־ ל֣וֹא׀ הִפְגַּ֣עְתִּֽי בְךָ֗ בְּעֵ֥ת־ רָעָ֛ה וּבְעֵ֥ת צָרָ֖ה אֶת־ הָאֹיֵֽב׃
verses.transliteration: ’ā·mar Yah·weh ’im- lō šå̄·rō·ṯi·ḵå̄ lə·ṭō·wḇ ’im- lō·w hip̄·ga‘·tî ḇə·ḵā bə·‘êṯ- rā·‘āh ū·ḇə·‘êṯ ṣā·rāh ’eṯ- hā·’ō·yêḇ
verses.literal: The LORD said Surely . . . I will deliver you for a good purpose surely I will . . . intercede with your enemy in your time of trouble in your time of distress
verses.literalPt: Jeová disse: Na verdade, te fortalecerei para o bem; na verdade, farei que o inimigo te suplique no tempo de calamidade e no tempo de aflição.

verses.original: הֲיָרֹ֨עַ בַּרְזֶ֧ל׀ בַּרְזֶ֛ל מִצָּפ֖וֹן וּנְחֹֽשֶׁת׃
verses.transliteration: hă·yā·rō·a‘ bar·zel bar·zel miṣ·ṣā·p̄ō·wn ū·nə·ḥō·šeṯ
verses.literal: Can anyone smash iron iron from the north or bronze
verses.literalPt: Acaso, pode alguém quebrar o ferro, o ferro do Norte, e o bronze?

verses.original: חֵילְךָ֧ וְאוֹצְרוֹתֶ֛יךָ לָבַ֥ז אֶתֵּ֖ן לֹ֣א בִמְחִ֑יר וּבְכָל־ חַטֹּאותֶ֖יךָ וּבְכָל־ גְּבוּלֶֽיךָ׃
verses.transliteration: ḥê·lə·ḵā wə·’ō·wṣ·rō·w·ṯe·ḵā lā·ḇaz ’et·tên lō ḇim·ḥîr ū·ḇə·ḵāl ḥaṭ·ṭō·w·ṯe·ḵā ū·ḇə·ḵāl gə·ḇū·le·ḵā
verses.literal: Your wealth and your treasures I will give up as plunder without charge for all your sins within all your borders
verses.literalPt: A tua substância e os teus tesouros, eu os darei sem preço ao saque, por todos os teus pecados e em todos os teus termos.

verses.original: וְהַֽעֲבַרְתִּי֙ אֶת־ אֹ֣יְבֶ֔יךָ בְּאֶ֖רֶץ לֹ֣א יָדָ֑עְתָּ כִּֽי־ אֵ֛שׁ קָדְחָ֥ה בְאַפִּ֖י עֲלֵיכֶ֥ם תּוּקָֽד׃ס
verses.transliteration: wə·ha·‘ă·ḇar·tî ’eṯ- ’ō·yə·ḇe·ḵā bə·’e·reṣ lō yā·ḏā·‘ə·tā kî- ’êš qā·ḏə·ḥāh ḇə·’ap·pî ‘ă·lê·ḵem tū·qāḏ
verses.literal: Then I will enslave you to your enemies in a land you do not know for My anger will kindle a fire that will burn against you
verses.literalPt: Farei que passes com os teus inimigos para uma terra que não sabes; porque o fogo se ateou na minha ira e sobre vós arderá.

verses.original: אַתָּ֧ה יָדַ֣עְתָּ יְהוָ֗ה זָכְרֵ֤נִי וּפָקְדֵ֙נִי֙ וְהִנָּ֤קֶם לִי֙ מֵרֹ֣דְפַ֔י אַל־ לְאֶ֥רֶךְ אַפְּךָ֖ תִּקָּחֵ֑נִי דַּ֕ע שְׂאֵתִ֥י עָלֶ֖יךָ חֶרְפָּֽה׃
verses.transliteration: ’at·tāh yā·ḏa‘·tā Yah·weh zā·ḵə·rê·nî ū·p̄ā·qə·ḏê·nî wə·hin·nā·qem lî mê·rō·ḏə·p̄ay ’al- lə·’e·reḵ ’ap·pə·ḵā tiq·qā·ḥê·nî da‘ śə·’ê·ṯî ‘ā·le·ḵā ḥer·pāh
verses.literal: You understand O LORD remember me and attend to me Avenge me against my persecutors In Your patience . . . do not take me away Know that I endure reproach for Your honor
verses.literalPt: Tu sabes, Jeová; lembra-te de mim, visita-me e vinga-me dos meus perseguidores; pela tua longanimidade, não me arrebates, eu te peço. Sabe que por amor de ti tenho sofrido afrontas.

verses.original: נִמְצְא֤וּ דְבָרֶ֙יךָ֙ וָאֹ֣כְלֵ֔ם וַיְהִ֤י דְבָרֶיךָ לִ֔י לְשָׂשׂ֖וֹן וּלְשִׂמְחַ֣ת לְבָבִ֑י כִּֽי־ נִקְרָ֤א שִׁמְךָ֙ עָלַ֔י יְהוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֵ֥י צְבָאֽוֹת׃ס
verses.transliteration: nim·ṣə·’ū ḏə·ḇā·re·ḵā wā·’ō·ḵə·lêm way·hî ḏə·ḇå̄·rɛ·ḵå̄ lî lə·śā·śō·wn ū·lə·śim·ḥaṯ lə·ḇā·ḇî kî- niq·rā šim·ḵā ‘ā·lay Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê ṣə·ḇā·’ō·wṯ
verses.literal: Your words were found and I ate them Your words became my joy . . . and my heart’s delight For I bear Your name . . . O LORD God of Hosts
verses.literalPt: Acharam-se as tuas palavras, e eu as comi; e as tuas palavras eram para mim o gozo e a alegria do meu coração. Pois sou chamado do teu nome, Jeová, Deus dos Exércitos.

verses.original: לֹֽא־ יָשַׁ֥בְתִּי בְסוֹד־ מְשַׂחֲקִ֖ים וָֽאֶעְלֹ֑ז מִפְּנֵ֤י יָֽדְךָ֙ בָּדָ֣ד יָשַׁ֔בְתִּי כִּֽי־ זַ֖עַם מִלֵּאתָֽנִי׃ס
verses.transliteration: lō- yā·šaḇ·tî ḇə·sō·wḏ- mə·śa·ḥă·qîm wā·’e‘·lōz mip·pə·nê yā·ḏə·ḵā bā·ḏāḏ yā·šaḇ·tî kî- za·‘am mil·lê·ṯā·nî
verses.literal: I never sat with the band of revelers nor did I celebrate with them Because Your hand was on me I sat alone for You have filled me with indignation
verses.literalPt: Não me sentei na assembleia dos que se alegram, nem me regozijei; sentei-me a sós por causa da tua mão, pois me encheste de indignação.

verses.original: לָ֣מָּה הָיָ֤ה כְאֵבִי֙ נֶ֔צַח וּמַכָּתִ֖י אֲנוּשָׁ֑ה֙ מֵֽאֲנָה֙ הֵֽרָפֵ֔א הָי֨וֹ תִֽהְיֶ֥ה לִי֙ כְּמ֣וֹ אַכְזָ֔ב מַ֖יִם לֹ֥א נֶאֱמָֽנוּ׃ס
verses.transliteration: lām·māh hā·yāh ḵə·’ê·ḇî ne·ṣaḥ ū·mak·kā·ṯî ’ă·nū·šāh mê·’ă·nāh hê·rā·p̄ê hā·yōw ṯih·yeh lî kə·mōw ’aḵ·zāḇ ma·yim lō ne·’ĕ·mā·nū
verses.literal: Why is my pain unending and my wound incurable refusing to be healed You have indeed become . . . like a mirage to me water that is not there
verses.literalPt: Por que é perpétua a minha dor, e, incurável, a minha ferida, que se recusa a ser curada? Acaso, ser-me-ás como um ribeiro enganoso, como águas que não são fiéis?

verses.original: לָכֵ֞ן כֹּֽה־ אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֗ה אִם־ תָּשׁ֤וּב וַאֲשִֽׁיבְךָ֙ לְפָנַ֣י תַּֽעֲמֹ֔ד וְאִם־ תּוֹצִ֥יא יָקָ֛ר מִזּוֹלֵ֖ל כְּפִ֣י תִֽהְיֶ֑ה יָשֻׁ֤בוּ הֵ֙מָּה֙ אֵלֶ֔יךָ וְאַתָּ֖ה לֹֽא־ תָשׁ֥וּב אֲלֵיהֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: lā·ḵên kōh- ’ā·mar Yah·weh ’im- tā·šūḇ wa·’ă·šî·ḇə·ḵā lə·p̄ā·nay ta·‘ă·mōḏ wə·’im- tō·w·ṣî yā·qār miz·zō·w·lêl kə·p̄î ṯih·yeh yā·šu·ḇū hêm·māh ’ê·le·ḵā wə·’at·tāh lō- ṯā·šūḇ ’ă·lê·hem
verses.literal: Therefore this is what the LORD says If you return I will restore you you will stand in My presence And if you speak words that are noble instead of worthless you will be My spokesman It is they who must turn to you but you must not turn to them
verses.literalPt: Portanto, assim diz Jeová: Se te tornares, então, te farei voltar, para que te apresentes diante de mim; e, se tirares do vil o precioso, serás como a minha boca; voltar-se-ão eles para ti, mas tu não te voltarás para eles.

verses.original: וּנְתַתִּ֜יךָ לָעָ֣ם הַזֶּ֗ה לְחוֹמַ֤ת נְחֹ֙שֶׁת֙ בְּצוּרָ֔ה וְנִלְחֲמ֥וּ אֵלֶ֖יךָ וְלֹא־ י֣וּכְלוּ לָ֑ךְ כִּֽי־ אִתְּךָ֥ אֲנִ֛י לְהוֹשִֽׁיעֲךָ֥ וּלְהַצִּילֶ֖ךָ נְאֻם־ יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: ū·nə·ṯat·tî·ḵā lā·‘ām haz·zeh lə·ḥō·w·maṯ nə·ḥō·šeṯ bə·ṣū·rāh wə·nil·ḥă·mū ’ê·le·ḵā wə·lō- yū·ḵə·lū lāḵ kî- ’it·tə·ḵā ’ă·nî lə·hō·wō·šî·‘ă·ḵā ū·lə·haṣ·ṣî·le·ḵā nə·’um- Yah·weh
verses.literal: Then I will make you a wall to this people a fortified wall of bronze they will fight against you but will not overcome you for I am with you to save and deliver you declares the LORD
verses.literalPt: Dar-te-ei a este povo por um muro fortificado e de bronze; eles pelejarão contra ti, porém contra ti não prevalecerão, porque eu sou contigo para te salvar e para te livrar, diz Jeová.

verses.original: וְהִצַּלְתִּ֖יךָ מִיַּ֣ד רָעִ֑ים וּפְדִתִ֖יךָ מִכַּ֥ף עָרִצִֽים׃פ
verses.transliteration: wə·hiṣ·ṣal·tî·ḵā mî·yaḏ rā·‘îm ū·p̄ə·ḏi·ṯî·ḵā mik·kap̄ ‘ā·ri·ṣîm
verses.literal: I will deliver you from the hand of the wicked and redeem you from the grasp of the ruthless
verses.literalPt: Livrar-te-ei das mãos dos iníquos e remir-te-ei das mãos dos terríveis.
